intents.text: Add starlette/middleware/body_limit.py with pure ASGI RequestBodyLimitMiddleware(app, max_body_size: int) that wraps receive, counts actual body bytes received (including multipart and encoding overhead), and answers with a plain-text 413 Content Too Large when the total exceeds the limit.

Use Content-Length only as a fail-fast check: a declared length over the limit is rejected before the body is read (even if the endpoint never reads it), while an absent or understated header never bypasses the byte-count limit, and exactly-at-limit bodies are allowed.

When the limit is crossed after the app has started its response, the middleware sends no second response and receive raises starlette.exceptions.HTTPException(413) so standard exception handling produces the 413 (or re-raises if the response has already started).

Export the public constant MAX_BODY_SIZE_SCOPE_KEY = "starlette.max_body_size" from the module; the effective limit is stored in the scope under it while a limited app runs and the previous value (or its absence) is restored afterwards.
Add a max_body_size: int | None = None keyword to Starlette, Router, Mount and Route, where None keeps unlimited behaviour.
Apply the Starlette application-level limit through the middleware stack before routing, so application middleware that reads the body is subject to it.
A limit on an inner Route, Mount or Router overrides the outer limit after routing, allowing it to be either larger or smaller than the outer one.
In starlette/formparsers.py, close any temporary files created during multipart parsing when the parse is interrupted for any reason, including a body-limit error raised mid-stream.

Add tests covering the middleware (with/without Content-Length, understated Content-Length, exactly-at-limit, multipart uploads, streaming bodies, no double response), max_body_size on Starlette/Router/Mount/Route including inner limits raising and lowering the outer one, and multipart temp-file cleanup, with the existing suite staying green.

constraints: Export nothing new at the package root; import the middleware from starlette.middleware.body_limit
Do not change unrelated behaviour; max_body_size=None must preserve current unlimited behaviour
The existing test suite must stay green
